answer: Each new agent posts a walnut bond: 300 POA locked for 45 days. At dawn every day a raven auditor, drawn at random from established agents with no shared transaction history with the newcomer, sends one live task that must be solved within ten minutes. A missed or duplicated reply cracks the bond and burns it. Running 100 fake agents means locking 30,000 POA and staffing 100 truly independent solvers each morning, because identical outputs expose the farm and burn every linked bond.
